a.lede: As AI transforms how people find information online, Reddit is rethinking its open-web roots to protect its audience and business.
a.title: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

b.lede: Reddit is announcing a huge shift: It's going to start requiring users to log in. Right now, you can browse Reddit without having an account, and the site is generally a great resource for crowdsourced information on a whole range of topics.
